main_text.p: poenis, & expurgentur etiam flammis, & poenis vltulatorijs. Et Conringius non dum respondit. Quod contra Allatium absq; vlla probatione dicitur ridiculum est; Nihil egis-se Allatium in illo tractatu, vt caufam fuam, fi non prodidit, exfibilandam faltem propinauerit. Contendantur modo inuicem ea, quae ὁ πάνυ Conringius scripserat cum ijs, quae Allatius repofuit, & patebit vnicuique praeiudicijs non fascinato, nihil aliud de scripto Allatij pronunciandum esse, quam ἀῤῥήτῳ ἀμάνω. Iam triumphat Conringius. Habuit fuæ causæ tutissimum patronum. Quis hisce obiectionibus, & argumentis contra Allatium respondebit?

In Ecclesia Graecanica sequiore occurrit nihilominus, & prob dolor! Apostasia a veteri orthodoxa, quod in subsequentibus clarum faciemus. Neque id agimus insultandi Graecis gratia, quorum potius miseremur, & iudicamus eos partim neglectu scripturae, & coeco obedientiae studio, partim tyrannide Turcica pressos in dewia discessisse, hodieque nimis rerum aliarum imperitis, imprudentesque sine vlterioricura, & indagine in antiquam siluam doctoribus ijsdem morbis laborantibus ire: quanquam sex illa ipsa Orthodoxia multa adhuc retinuerint. Et haec ne faciunt ad probandum schisma cum Pontificijs? Sed antequam examinentur, proponantur singula; Mutabilitas In-fer-

page.notes: Lines 4-5: the word "egisse" is split across the line end and the printed form is unclear ("egisf." / "fe"); read as egis-se [?]. Line 11: the Greek phrase "ἀῤῥήτῳ ἀμάνω" is only roughly legible; the letters are uncertain. Line 7: "ὁ πάνυ" is copied as seen, with the accent not certain. The word "dewia" is kept as printed. "sex illa" (last paragraph, line 2 from end) reads "sex" as printed but may be a misreading of "ipsa". Long s has been normalised to s throughout. The page ends mid-word with "In-fer-" and no catchword follows.
